page.notes: The vertical left-edge line "PHYSICA (scientia rerum naturalium : est autem de" is transcribed as the diagram root. It is printed sideways, reading upward. The Greek word in the subtitle is not legible on the scan, so it is marked as illegible. "Cerulew" is uncertain: the letter after "Cerul" could be m or w. "Medij:vel" is doubtful: the mark after "Medi" could be j, 9 or i, so it is marked [?]. "seil" in "or seil." appears to be a printing error, probably for "scil.", and is left as printed. "Exacte. Ru / bor." is one word split across lines, read as "Rubor.". The brace structure is read from the drawing, and the levels follow the braces.
